addRoutine.q: How do I add a routine?
addRoutine.a: Tap the + button on a category in My Room, or add one from the routine management screen.

currency.q: How do I earn coins and diamonds?
currency.a: You earn coins by completing routines every day. Spend coins on the gacha; if you draw an item you already own, it turns into diamonds. Use diamonds to buy furniture in room decoration.

friends.q: How do I play with friends?
friends.a: Create a new house from the House tab or join a friend's house to keep up routines together.
